title: Fix verify-lean Charon extraction failure in gfpn ext config
description:
`./scripts/verify-lean.sh` currently fails on mainline before the `cad241e6` SIMD work is merged. The observed failure is during Charon extraction of `gf2-core` with `--no-default-features`, around `crates/gf2-core/src/gfpn/ext_config.rs:57`, with a Charon type error followed by stack overflow. Because `cad241e6` has a hard criterion that the Lean4 verification pipeline still builds, it must remain blocked until the baseline pipeline is fixed.

## Background

The `cad241e6` worktree rework demonstrated that the failure is baseline-identical on the branch base (`0c4e2fb`) and that the new SIMD code is gated behind `#[cfg(feature = "simd")]`, while `scripts/verify-lean.sh` extracts `gf2-core` with `--no-default-features`. That makes this a verification-tooling blocker rather than a `cad241e6` implementation defect.

The fix should preserve the production verification contract: the full `./scripts/verify-lean.sh` pipeline must run from repository root and complete successfully, including Charon extraction, Aeneas translation/post-processing, and `lake build`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `./scripts/verify-lean.sh` passes from the repository root on the current mainline branch.
- [hard] The fix keeps exercising the intended production `gfp/` and `gfpn/` code paths; it must not hide the relevant field arithmetic behind a broad opaque/exclude rule just to make extraction pass.
- [hard] If a Charon/Aeneas compatibility workaround is required, it is narrowly scoped, documented in the relevant script or proof workaround file, and includes enough context to remove it later.
- [hard] Existing committed Lean files still build with `cd proofs && lake build`.
- [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-core --all-features --release --profile ci` passes.
- [hard] `cargo clippy -p gf2-core --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes.

## Notes

This is a blocker for `cad241e6` only because that task requires the Lean4 proof pipeline to remain green. Do not merge `cad241e6` until this issue is done.
